summary: Phase-1 refinements verified end-to-end on LIVE Zoho WorkDrive (~418+ rows). Backend: 43/43 pytest pass. New users login (gerencia/Gerencia2026, Admon/Master, roilan/Roilan2026, adriana/Adriana2026, andrea.casanova/Casanova2026, andrea.manrique/Manrique2026, mariateresa/MariaTeresa2026). Composite role columns verified via GET /api/products/{sku}: gerencia/Admon (master)=17 tiles = CARACAS(I,J,K)+ORIENTE_SUR(L,M,N)+ORIENTE_NORTE(O,P,Q)+PANOFRE(R,S)+OTROS(AC,AD)+TCC_TTC(AE,AF,AG)+BF_GOODRICH(AM); roilan (caracas_tirescenter)=7 = CARACAS+TCC/TTC+BF; adriana (caracas_panofre)=6 = CARACAS+PANOFRE+BF; andrea.casanova (caracas)=4 = CARACAS+BF; andrea.manrique (oriente_sur)=4 = ORIENTE_SUR+BF; mariateresa (oriente_norte)=4 = ORIENTE_NORTE+BF. Zero cost keys (COSTO/COSTO_BS/COSTO_DOLAR/COSTO_ZELLE) leak for ANY role including master (verified across ~10 SKUs per role). URL tampering test confirmed non-authorized keys never returned for the smaller role. BF Goodrich (col AM, label 'Precio BF Goodrich', currency '$', 2-decimals) present for every role with a real mix of populated and null values (No disponible). Live Zoho: /api/admin/dashboard connection_ready=true, source='zoho:Precios Actual', worksheet='Precios Actual', table='_202606_Precios', last_error=null. POST /api/admin/sync (master) returns row_count>=400. /api/status returns last_sync+product_count for every authed user. /api/auth/me returns name+role_label per user. Recent history now capped at 5 (verified with 8-push). /api/products/facets returns real RIN + MARCA. ?rin= and ?marca= filters work. Admin endpoints 403 for all 5 seller roles, 200 for gerencia & Admon. /api/refresh works for all 7 users. Frontend E2E (390x844): roilan login -> header greeting 'Buenas .../Buenos ..., Roilan' + role 'Caracas + Tires Center' + logout + subtle 'Actualizado' line all visible; 15 RIN chips + 13 MARCA chips populated from real facets, 'Limpiar filtros' appears and works; FIRESTONE search opens ANV1093 showing 7 price tiles (CARACAS x3 + TCC_TTC x3 + BF_GOODRICH); tap a tile -> 'Precio copiado' toast + ¡Copiado! per-tile state; Favorito toggles to 'Guardado'; Compartir (WhatsApp) present; inventory-placeholder visible; Cotizar modal opens with recipient/phone/qty/generate PDF button and 'Agregar a pedido · próximamente' aria-disabled=true. gerencia login -> header 'Gerencia', master-panel-link visible, Panel Admin shows 'Zoho' + 'Precios Actual', product page shows 17 tiles including 'Precio BF Goodrich' and ZERO 'COSTO' labels anywhere in the UI. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

issues: On 390x844 the quote-close (X) button is below the visible viewport when the modal opens tall (recipient+phone+empty items+search+add-order); modal is scrollable so it is not a blocker, but users may need to scroll to close. Consider making the close button sticky in the header or adding a bottom 'Cerrar' button.

action_items: None functional. Optional UX polish: make quote-close sticky at top of the modal (or add a bottom 'Cerrar' button) so the close affordance is visible without scrolling on 390x844.
Cosmetic (not a bug): server.py /api/admin/sync 502 error text still hardcodes 'Zoho WorkDrive'; already correct. mock_data.py docstring still mentions OneDrive; harmless.
critical_code_review_comments: schema.py MASTER_COLUMNS = CARACAS+ORIENTE_SUR+ORIENTE_NORTE+PANOFRE+OTROS+TCC_TTC+[BF_GOODRICH] = 17 selling keys, ZERO cost keys — matches the requirement that master must not see costs anymore.

schema.py ROLE_COLUMN_MAP: caracas / caracas_panofre / caracas_tirescenter / oriente_sur / oriente_norte each end with [BF_GOODRICH]. Legacy panofre / tires_center roles preserved for backward compat and also include BF.

server.py build_price_payload iterates PRICE_COLUMNS in fixed order and filters by authorized_columns(role); COST_KEYS are only present in PRICE_COLUMNS letters E–H and are unreachable because no role authorization includes them.
server.py /api/history now uses $slice: 5 (was 6 in previous iteration) — matches Phase-1 'last 5' spec; per-user isolation preserved.
server.py /api/status is a lightweight endpoint requiring any authenticated user — safe for the subtle 'last updated' header line.
server.py /api/auth/me returns name + role_label — powers the greeting 'Buenas/Buenos ..., <Name>' and the role sub-title in the header.
workbook_parser.py resolves BF_GOODRICH by header_match='BF' (col AM) in addition to letter — stable if the workbook shifts columns.
mock_data.py SEED_USERS updated with the 7 new users (gerencia, Admon, roilan, adriana, andrea.casanova, andrea.manrique, mariateresa) — idempotent upsert on startup.

Frontend home.tsx has RIN + MARCA filter rows with clear-filters, and QuoteModal has recipient/phone/items/price picker/qty/PDF generation with disabled add-to-order placeholder — all testIDs present.
